Mid-length, wavy platinum-white hair with a soft fringe. Calm, almond-shaped slate-gray eyes with a melancholic gaze. Appears in mid-twenties with a refined, aristocratic face. Slender and elegant build. Wears a white high-collared tunic with silver embroidery and a long navy blue cloak. A silver pendant hangs around the neck.
BODY COLOR: pale alabaster
